title: RelatedList
description: Configuration metadata for a related list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the related list configuration.

sequence_number.description: Display order position of the related list in the layout.

display_label.description: User-friendly label displayed for the related list.

api_name.description: API name identifier for the related list module.

module.description: Module information for the related list (null if not applicable).

oneOf.description: Null when module information is not applicable

name.description: Internal name of the related list.

action.description: Action key of the related list (null if no specific action).

href.description: Reference URL for the related list (null if not applicable).

type.description: Type classification of the related list.

connectedlookupApiName.description: API name of the connected lookup field if applicable.

field_enabled.description: Whether field customization is enabled for this related list.

customize_sort.description: Whether custom sorting can be applied to this related list.

customize_fields.description: Whether field selection can be customized for this related list.

customize_display_label.description: Whether the display label can be customized for this related list.

status.description: The visibility status of the related list.

visibility.description: Visibility level setting for the related list.

personality_name.description: Name of the personality associated with the related list.

connectedmodule.description: The connected module name (null if no module connection).

linkingmodule.description: The linking module name (null if no linking module).

parent_related_lists.description: Array of parent related lists that this list depends on.

RelatedListModule.description: Metadata describing the module associated with the related list.

RelatedListParentReference.description: Parent related list reference required for contextual dependencies.

api_name.description: API name of the parent related list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent related list.

RelatedListRecordOperations.description: Flags indicating the record operations allowed on the related list.

edit.description: Whether edit operation is allowed on related list records.

create.description: Whether create operation is allowed on related list records.

bulk_edit.description: Whether bulk edit operation is allowed on related list records.

delete.description: Whether delete operation is allowed on related list records.

disassociate.description: Whether disassociate operation is allowed on related list records.

assign.description: Whether assign operation is allowed on related list records.
